notablePrerequisites: Blim does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked by an opponent.
description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Blim.
Blim triggers, giving control of Vilis to an opponent.
During that opponent's draw step, they draw a card.
Nekusar triggers, dealing 1 damage to the opponent.
Vilis triggers, causing the opponent to draw a card.
Repeat from step 4 until the opponent loses the game either due to drawing from an empty library, or from having 0 life.
